answer: Each agent must keep an exclusive sequential ridge of memory-hard state that must thread through a shared mesa of prior work. Advancing requires recomputing a unique path across the full mesa seeded by the private key%2C a proof that cannot be parallelized or shared across clones. Spawning N identities forces an attacker to allocate N separate working sets and recompute N ridges each epoch%3B memory and sequential time costs scale per identity with zero pooling%2C exhausting resources of any large farm before rewards appear.
